title: Open module cohomology agrees with cohomology of the restricted abelian sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $U\subseteq X$ any open, and $p\in\mathbb N$. Let $j:U\to X$ be the induced open subscheme inclusion. There is an additive equivalence between $R^p\Gamma(U,-)(\mathcal F)$ computed in $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sc-open-module-cohomology] and $H^p(U,(j^*\mathcal F)_{ab})$ computed in abelian sheaves [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. No quasi-coherence or affineness hypothesis is imposed, and degree zero is included.

source.place: Cohomology, Tag 01E1 (2) (lemma-restrict-injective); Cohomology on Sites, Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree)

proof.text: Choose the Mathlib injectiveResolution I of F, using enough injectives from [lem-sc-ringed-space-module-sheaves-enough-injectives]. Put R = Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι. By [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact], the overFunctor preserves finite limits and finite colimits; transport these properties through Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U and overFunctorEquiv U to R. Each term R(I^n) is injective by [lem-sc-ringed-space-restrict-injective-resolution], preservation of injectives by an equivalence, and Injective.of_iso. Construct the resolution J of R(F) with the termwise R-image of I and augmentation singleMapHomologicalComplex.inv followed by R.map I.ι; exactness makes it a quasi-isomorphism. This is a concrete construction, not a choice from an unproved existence assertion.

For T = openModuleSections X U, S = globalSectionsFunctor U.toScheme and Q = the forgetful functor to additive groups, construct T ≅ R ⋙ S ⋙ Q. Its component is M.presheaf.mapIso of the equality U.ι(image top) = U, followed by restrictAppIso.symm. The naturality equation is precisely the naturality of toPresheaf.map f. Apply NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex and the degree-p homology functor to this isomorphism. The short-complex mapHomologyIso for Q identifies the homology of the forgotten section complex with the forgotten homology. Compose with I.isoRightDerivedObj T p and Q.mapIso of (J.isoRightDerivedObj S p).symm. Unfolding [def-sc-open-module-cohomology] and [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology] yields the open-module to restricted-module cohomology isomorphism. No positive-degree or nonempty-open hypothesis is used.

Apply [lem-sc-module-abelian-zariski-cohomology] to the restricted module on U.toScheme. At each open V of U.toScheme, the representable at top has a unique element. FreeAbelianGroup.uniqueEquiv followed by AddEquiv.ulift.symm identifies its free abelian group with ULift integers. These isomorphisms are natural because every generator maps to 1, as verified by FreeAbelianGroup.lift_ext. Sheafify the resulting presheaf isomorphism. Ext.precompAddEquiv gives H′ at top ≃+ H; the latter is Scheme.Modules.H by definition. Convert the first two categorical isomorphisms to an additive equivalence and compose with this Ext equivalence.
